name: m4-branch-synth-pekko
description: Per first-parent commit from Scala 2.13.18 through upstream 2.13.x to the tip of the refreshed `scala2-perf-integration` ([retronym/scala#231](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/231), `e182fb9fd2`): what each step does to a compile of pekko-actor and pekko-stream 1.7.1.

The branch `perf-int-pekko-synth` is synthetic, built from real trees: 2.13.18 with its STARR bumped to 2.13.19-M1 (2.13.17's cannot compile the library on JDK 26), then upstream 2.13.x at [`632df4153c`](https://github.com/scala/scala/compare/v2.13.18...632df4153c21bf0513f5735967fb1220185ab78a), then one commit per first-parent commit of the integration branch with that commit's tree and message. retronym/scala#249 is the first merge after 2.13.x. The test-only, check-file and PERF-INTEGRATION.md commits change no compiler code, so they are A/A controls for their neighbours.

On the M4, 3 rounds, xctrace ipc; compiler built with release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); the corpus is compiled plainly. Patched JDK 26, `jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`; 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation (`-Xmn3g -XX:-G1UseAdaptiveIHOP`) and `-XX:hashCode=3`; single-shot, 8 warmup and 10 measured, warmup from the plateau in `m4-integ-pekko-2`.
